entry_change_only.long: completed close crosses from not-above to above max(plotted Leading Span A, plotted Leading Span B); execute next bar open
entry_change_only.short: completed close crosses from not-below to below min(plotted Leading Span A, plotted Leading Span B); execute next bar open

unchanged_rules.target: Keltner EMA20 + ATR20 Wilder RMA x3, executable threshold shifted 1 bar
unchanged_rules.stop: fixed 2ATR20 from the completed signal candle
unchanged_rules.gap_stop: fill at bar open when open gaps beyond stop
unchanged_rules.cost: 4 bps fee + 1 bp slippage per side = 0.10% round trip
unchanged_rules.capital_model: R$500 initial, fixed 10x current equity, reinvest trade by trade

baseline_validation_same_data.description: Frozen Span-A/Span-B entry logic recalculated on the same Binance bars to validate the experimental calculation path.
baseline_validation_same_data.note: Matches the previously frozen August result to floating-point tolerance; live/forward files were not modified.
